test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A bike crosses a bridge with a speed of 75 km/h. What will be the length (in km) of the bridge, if the bike takes 20 minutes to cross the bridge?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the bike = 75 km/h.

Time taken to cross the bridge = 20 minutes = 20/60 hours = 1/3 hours.

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Let the length of the bridge be x km.

⇒ x = 75 km/h × 1/3 h

⇒ x = 75/3 km

⇒ x = 25 km

**The length of the bridge is 25 km.**
